name: Demon Add
source: I am alone. As usual, I am browsing the net because I'm bored and sleep can't be found. Suddenly, an add appears. (Yes, an ad -- with double D -- if you know what I mean.) It says something about demons. Huh?
translation: 我独自一人。像往常一样，我因为无聊而无法睡觉而上网。突然，出现了一个添加。（是的，一个广告——带有双D——如果你明白我的意思的话。）它讲述了一些关于恶魔的事情。啊？
